item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00058","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C07","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 provides a concrete two-section drafting template almost identical to the child: it designates a defense-connected agency as a “Department” under section 103(a), then applies Title I to that agency’s contracts and related subcontracts for amounts received or accrued from a specified date, regardless of when the contracts were made. The child substitutes the Federal Facilities Corporation and new dates and adds a third transitional-rights provision. C07 and C08 use the same machinery and highly similar language, but C04 is the closest singular-agency predecessor and shares the “further designation” framing.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Federal Facilities Corporation, which exercises functions having a direct and immediate connection with the national defense, is hereby designated, pursuant to subsection (a) of section 103 of the Act, as an agency included within the definition of the term \"Department\" for the purposes of Title I of the Act.","parent_excerpt":"The Bureau of Reclamation, which exercises functions having direct and immediate connection with the national defense, is hereby designated, pursuant to section 103 (a) of the Act, as an agency of the Government included within the definition of the term \"Department\" for the purposes of Title I of the Act.","explanation":"Nearly verbatim designation provision, with the designated agency and minor phrasing changed."},{"child_excerpt":"In accordance with section 102 of the Act, the provisions of Title I of the Act shall be applicable to all contracts with the Federal Facilities Corporation and related subcontracts, to the extent of the amounts received or accrued on or after the first day of October, 1954, whether such contracts or subcontracts were made on, before, or after that date.","parent_excerpt":"In accordance with section 102 of the Act, the provisions of Title I of the Act shall be applicable to all contracts with the Bureau of Reclamation, and related subcontracts, to the extent of the amounts received or accrued on or after the first day of July, 1952, whether such contracts or subcontracts were made on, before, or after that date.","explanation":"The operative contract-coverage clause is essentially identical apart from the agency and effective date."}]}
